meta.headline: 15 filed picks graded across 2 sources — Morning card 3–5–1 · Afternoon card 3–3. Each source keeps its own record — they are never blended into one.
notes: Morning card: review-crew/grading_soccer_morning_2026-11-04.md (ESPN match summaries + Sportscafe/Sofascore/UEFA for passes; the FotMob fullstats file named in the manifest contains no Nov 4 rows - max date 2026-11-01). Afternoon card: review-crew/grading_othersports_2026-11-04.md + soccer/placed_parlay_2026-11-04.md (ESPN box scores). Verdicts: review-crew/review_soccer_2026-11-04.md.
